purpose: Keep CORE bootstrap proof generation aligned with the committed Memory Muster generation without unnecessary generation churn.
contracts: Identical protected six-vessel registry/admission/manifest refreshes retain the current Memory Muster generation.
Every genuine Memory Muster generation advance queues exactly one serialized CORE proof relay.
A stale or superseded generation may never overwrite or satisfy a newer generation.
Final proof may commit only when Core = Memory = Dock = Intelligence generation and all six protected IDs are present.
Legacy lifecycle hooks and localStorage quota state are diagnostic only when the verified loader and Storage-Safe Proof Bus are healthy.
release_gate: Current Memory and CORE generation must align before Command Navigation can be treated as proven.

generation_settlement_contract.memory: must be committed with all six protected vessels
generation_settlement_contract.dock: canonical six-vessel input must survive the source pipeline and the live Dock surface must be healthy; user filter/search is presentation-only
generation_settlement_contract.intelligence: usable six-vessel Fleet Intelligence surface must attach to the same generation
generation_settlement_contract.commit: one idempotent finalizer may commit only when memory, Dock, and Intelligence share the same generation
generation_settlement_contract.partial_observations: diagnostic history only; never current proof
